create_pool_wiring: create a PoolWiring object to define edge state mappings for pool factors in a factor graph
build_pool_factor: build a PoolFactor enforcing that all pool choices are zero or exactly one is selected when the pool indicator is one
compile_pool_wiring: compile a PoolWiring from factor edge states, variable mappings, and factor sizes using logical factor infrastructure
concatenate_pool_wirings: concatenate a sequence of PoolWiring objects into a single combined PoolWiring
run_pool_messages: run loopy belief propagation messages from pool factors to variables with configurable temperature and normalization
